headline: Anthropic adds dynamic workflows to Claude Managed Agents for up to 1,000 parallel sub-agents
body: Anthropic is adding dynamic workflows to Claude Managed Agents, where a lead agent creates a plan and distributes tasks to sub-agents. In Anthropic's testing, a single agent caught between 14 and 27 of 70 bugs in a 116,000-line codebase per run, while the dynamic workflow consistently hit 66, The Decoder reports.
note: For banks and insurers testing agent workloads, the token bill now sits next to the accuracy gain. The Decoder calls cost-effectiveness debatable, and Anthropic recommends starting small.

evidence.text: Anthropic is adding dynamic workflows to its Claude Managed Agents, bringing multi-agent orchestration to the platform.
A lead agent creates a plan, distributes tasks to sub-agents, and merges the results when they're done.
Up to 1,000 agents can run in parallel per execution.
Anthropic points to its own testing: The team hid 70 bugs in a 116,000-line codebase and found that a single agent caught between 14 and 27 per run, while the dynamic workflow consistently hit 66.
Whether this is cost-effective seems debatable.
Because these workflows can burn through "a lot of tokens," Anthropic recommends starting small.
